name: Damboa

queries.query: site:gov.ng Damboa Borno cadastral parcel GIS land registry map
queries.result: First-party discovery found Borno State Geographic Information Service (BOGIS), whose official site says it administers land matters including title, registration, searches, and geospatial data; its public properties route is not a parcel viewer. The BOGIS regulations identify a Cadastral Administration System and official digital repository, but do not expose an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint in the reviewed pages.

queries.result: No first-party Hausa-language cadastral viewer or parcel response was found. Discovery still led to the official English BOGIS site and its official Borno land-regulation document; no local-language query was submitted to a registry, and no parcel geometry was inferred.

registryEvidence.custodian: Borno State Geographic Information Service (BOGIS), Borno State Government; the public site gives its Maiduguri contact location and states that BOGIS administers land matters in Borno State.
registryEvidence.locality: Damboa is in Borno State; the reviewed first-party BOGIS material is state-wide and does not expose a Damboa-specific parcel layer or office endpoint.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Local state land-administration custody is evidenced, but Damboa-specific open parcel coverage is not established.

officialSources.observation: Official BOGIS homepage states that the service maps and secures land/property titles and administers land matters, registration, searches, and geospatial data in Borno.
Official public properties route returned a page with a loading image and no public map, search form, service configuration, or parcel response.
Official regulations define the BOGIS Land Administration System, Cadastral Administration System, Digital Data Repository, and UTM Zone 32N/Minna as the official coordinate system.
Separate current BOGIS application has a public login page and exposes registration/application settings, but parcel/application access is behind authentication; no login or credentials were used.

parcelDiscovery.crs: BOGIS regulations specify UTM Zone 32N/Minna for official cadastral maps; no parcel geometry was returned to validate a city response.
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was available from the public properties route or reviewed first-party pages. The login page was observed but not entered, and no private or unsafe fields were requested.
parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test. No parcel polygon is retained.
